Marissa / Olga — looping you in. Lucie from AeroMed is asking for a temporary credit lift (~€180k) to cover pilot ramp, with a preference for a phased collection ladder and clarity on VAT pass-through vs reverse-charge.

My proposal (subject to finance sign-off):
- Approve conditional credit band up to €250k for a 90-day pilot window, contingent on: 10% upfront holdback (applied to first invoice), signed amendment to MSA, and receipt of valid VAT certificate.
- Invoice cadence: month 1 = 30% due Net30, month 2 = 40% due Net45, month 3 = 30% due Net60 (we can tighten to Net45 if Ops needs predictability).
- If VAT evidence validates reverse-charge, mark invoices net of Redwood VAT; otherwise VAT passes through and is included on the invoice.

Attachments: proposed-collection-ladder-v1.xlsx (I sketched the tiers). Can you please:
1) Confirm the off-ramp conditions (credit checks / overdue flags) and any policy objections.
2) If OK, Marissa — can you run a quick credit spot-check on AeroMed (trade refs + recent bank confirmation)?
3) Olga — please prepare a redline to the MSA amendment to capture the temporary credit band and holdback.

I can run the concession through Sales Ops & Legal tomorrow morning if you sign off.

Thanks — Jonas

Redwood Inference

Subject: Approval: conditional credit band granted (90 days) + next steps

Team — decision and next steps below. Thanks for the quick turn.

Decision: Approve a conditional credit band up to €250,000 for a 90-day pilot window with the following controls (effective immediately upon signed amendment & receipt of deposit):
- Holdback: 10% applied to first invoice (or 10% deposit received in cleared funds).
- Invoice ladder: Month 1 = 30% (Net30), Month 2 = 40% (Net45), Month 3 = 30% (Net60). We will honor Lucie's preference to tighten month 1/2 to Net45 upon mutual agreement after first invoice clears.
- VAT handling: Treat as reverse-charge if AeroMed provides validated EU tax cert mapped to paying entity; otherwise Redwood will invoice VAT-inclusive and tax will be passed through. Tax to confirm entity mapping.
- Off-ramps: automatic rollback of credit band if any invoice exceeds 45 days past due or if monthly AR % > 20% for the customer.

Action items:
1) Olga — finalize a short amendment (3 clauses) to cover temporary credit band, holdback, and off-ramps. Send DocuSign link to AeroMed. Deadline: EOD Wed.
2) Marissa — complete credit spot-check and confirm bank remittance details; coordinate PO validation. Deadline: 48h.
3) Rishi — add weekly AR aging alert for AeroMed to Sales Ops and set up a KPI for pilot (D-8347).
4) Lucie / Marco — send deposit confirmation and PO number.

I'll send a succinct email to Legal & Sales Ops to document the concession. If controls execute cleanly, we'll re-evaluate the band at day 60 and either extend or roll back.

Jonas Weber
VP, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
